message.content: The description model already covers case_h well. I'll add a small refinement to help the Skeptic/Experimenter: the metric is a global vector L2 over all 64 rows, and the double permutation (rng.permutation then PERMUTATION) means small terms can appear before large ±w pairs, which is what drives cancellation error.
